options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: download_location
options.description: Absolute path of the scripts used to store the downloaded connection plugin.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Specifies the network endpoint of the Protection Source where it is reachable. It could be an URL or hostname or an IP address of the Protection Source

options.name: netmask_bits
options.description: Applicable when the platform type is PostgreSQL and state is present. Is required to add the SapHana hosts to the cluster's global allow lists.

options.name: platform
options.description: Type of the UDA source to be registered.

options.name: scripts_dir
options.description: Absolute path of the scripts used to interact with the UDA source.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Protection Source

options.name: upgrade
options.description: Determines whether to upgrade the connector plugin if already installed.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.
